headline: Goldman Sachs: Interest Rates in Türkiye May Stay High for Longer
summary: Goldman Sachs economists said Turkish rates may remain high longer than markets expect, citing high energy prices and the lira's depreciation.
why: Goldman Sachs is a major global investment bank whose economic forecasts are followed closely by investors in emerging-market rates and currencies.
